action.disconnectAndUnblock: Disconnect and turn off kill switch block

summary.unknown: Couldn’t read the VPN status. Refresh to check.
summary.restoringAccess: Don’t rely on this connection until server access is restored.
summary.monitorUnavailable: The VPN monitor isn’t responding, so kill switch status is unknown.
summary.otherServer: Another server is connected. Open it to disconnect.
summary.androidApps: Only the selected apps use the VPN.
summary.windowsApps: Selected apps use the VPN. System DNS goes through the server.
summary.launchedApps: Apps launched from SirinVPN use the VPN.
summary.selectedRoutes: Selected networks use the VPN. Everything else doesn’t.
summary.fullTunnelLan: Internet traffic uses the VPN. Local network traffic doesn’t.
summary.fullTunnel: All internet traffic goes through the VPN.
summary.waitingAndroidLockdown: Android blocks traffic until you reconnect.
summary.waitingBlocked: Traffic is blocked. Reconnect, or disconnect to unblock.
summary.waiting: Automatic reconnect is off. Reconnect when you’re ready.
summary.disconnected: Your traffic isn’t using the VPN.

warning.accessContained: Server access is being restored. VPN traffic is held until it finishes.
warning.accessUnenforced: Server access checks aren’t working. Don’t rely on this server until they’re restored.
warning.androidLockdown: Android’s “Block connections without VPN” stays on after you disconnect.
warning.killSwitchFailed: The kill switch couldn’t be verified. Don’t rely on it until this is fixed.
warning.androidAppsUnverified: Couldn’t verify app routing. Check the connection before relying on it.
warning.appsUnverified: Couldn’t verify app routing. New app launches are off.
warning.dnsDown: The server’s DNS isn’t responding. Run diagnostics.
warning.ipv6: Couldn’t route or block IPv6. Check the connection.

consequence.android: Android’s VPN settings control traffic blocking.
consequence.desktop: Disconnecting also lifts the kill switch block and stops auto-reconnect.

componentUpdate.needed: Update the VPN component to connect.

health.idle: No recent handshake. The connection may just be idle.

android.unverified: Couldn’t verify Android’s routing or blocking.
android.packages: Selected apps use the VPN and its DNS. Other apps bypass it unless Android blocks them.
android.lockdown: Android’s “Block connections without VPN” is on for all apps.

apps.notReady: App routing isn’t ready. New launches are off.
apps.windows: Selected apps use the VPN for IPv4; their IPv6 is blocked. DNS uses the server.
apps.launched: Launched apps and their DNS use the VPN. Other apps use your normal network.

firewall.verifiedSelectedRoutes: Firewall verified for selected routes and DNS.
firewall.verifiedLanAllowed: Firewall verified for IPv4, IPv6 and DNS. LAN allowed.
firewall.verified: Firewall verified for IPv4, IPv6 and DNS.

details.serverResponseInfo: How long the server takes to answer a status request. It isn’t VPN latency.

traffic.label: This device’s traffic
traffic.updateNeeded: Live rates need a VPN component update.

device.latencyInfo: Average round trip to the server through the VPN. It isn’t internet speed.
device.countersNote: Counters reset when you reconnect. No history is kept.

server.title: Server
server.unavailable: Server stats are unavailable. They’ll return automatically.
server.pollingNote: Update the server software for live stats.
server.activityUnreadable: Couldn’t read device activity from the server.
server.activityUnsupported: This server can’t report device activity. Update it to turn this on.
server.totalsInfo: Totals cover all devices since the server’s VPN started.
